Name: The Stardew Squad Cod Retired Life Add-on
Author: lolakazam
Description:
[font=Courier New][size=5]About this mod[/size][/font]
This is a personalized add-on of The Stardew Squad for Keegan and Ghost from Cod Retired life. Though the mod’s companion system can be used with any NPC, its dialogue and graphics revolve around the vanilla characters. This mod includes custom content specific to Keegan and Ghost.

[size=5][font=Courier New]Features[/font][/size]
[quote]• [b]Custom Dialogue[/b][i]:[/i] Replaces generic companion dialogue with custom dialogue tailored to fit Keegan and Ghost, with their personality in mind.
• [b]Custom Sitting Sprites[/b]: Adds unique sitting sprites for both NPCs.
• [b]Portuguese Translation[/b]: Includes a Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR) translation of the custom content.[/quote]
[size=5][font=Courier New]Requirements and [/font][/size][size=5][font=Courier New]Credits[/font][/size]
[quote]• The Stardew Squad [b][i]by Isaldae[/i][/b]
• Cod Retired Life [b][i]by mhly[/i][/b][/quote][quote]• Custom dialogue, sitting sprites, and Portuguese translation by me.[/quote]
[b][i][color=#cc0000]This is an unofficial add-on and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the original mod authors. [/color][/i][/b]
[b][i][color=#cc0000]TESTED ONLY ON MOBILE.[/color][/i][/b]
